title: Incremental task-sync export starts one git cat-file per task (5,165 on TermAl) and runs past 300 s after a rebuild bootstrap
outcome: Incremental task-sync export starts one git cat-file per task (5,165 on TermAl) and runs past 300 s after a rebuild bootstrap
acceptance: On TermAl's Central store (5,165 tasks), an ordinary incremental export right after a recorded export (cursor-only, no task changed) completes within 60 s and starts a number of git processes that does not grow with the task count
An ordinary incremental export with a few changed tasks reads, via git, only those tasks' blobs (or a bounded batch), never one git process per task in the project

A deterministic count test on fixtures of different sizes (e.g. 200 and 2,000 tasks) shows git process starts for the first incremental export after an export --rebuild bootstrap do not scale with project size
